Default tuning grids for the STR estimator

Source: R/cv.R
hr_grid.Rd

The ridge grid is geometric between kmin_ratio * d1^2 and d1^2, where d1 is the largest singular value of the prepared design. For each ridge value the threshold grid is c * max|ridge|, c in [0, 0.99].

Usage

hr_grid(
  X,
  y,
  nk = 12,
  ng = 40,
  kmin_ratio = 1e-04,
  intercept = TRUE,
  standardize = TRUE
)

Arguments

X

design matrix.

y

response.

nk

number of ridge values.

ng

number of threshold values.

kmin_ratio

smallest ridge value relative to the squared leading singular value.

intercept, standardize

passed to the design preparation.

Value

A list with the vector k and the matrix gamma (nk x ng), one row of thresholds per ridge value, and fraction, recomputed on the training response inside each CV fold.
